verses.en: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.sm: UA oti Samuelu, ona faapotopoto ai lea o Isaraelu uma, ua latou taufaitagitu‘i ia te ia, ma tanu ia te ia i lona fale i Eama. Ua tulai Tavita, ma alu ifo i le vao o Parana.

verses.en: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.sm: Sa i ai le tasi tagata i Meona, o ana mea foi sa i Karamelu; ua tagata ola lava ia, sa ia te ia o rnamoe e tolu gaafe, ma ‘oti e tasi le afe ; sa sele fulufulu o ana mamoe i Karamelu.

verses.en: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
verses.sm: G Napalu le igoa o le tagata, o Apikaila le igoa o lana avā ; o le fafine mafaufau lelei, ma le lalelei, a o le tane o le finauvale ia ma le leaga i ana mea e fai; o le sa Kalepō foi o ia.

verses.en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Tavita i le vao, o loo sele e Napalu fulufulu o ana mamoe ;

verses.en: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
verses.sm: ona auina atu lea e Tavita o taulelea e toasefulu ; ua faapea ane Tavimelu, ma o atu ia Napalu, ma ofo atu ia te ia i lo‘u igoa ;

verses.en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
verses.sm: tou te faapea atu i le ua tagata ola, Ia manuia oe, ia manuia lou aiga, ia manuia au mea uma lava.

verses.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua au faalogo atu o loo ia te oe e ua sele fulufulu; o lenei, o au leoleo mamoe sa matou nonofo ma i matou, sa le afaina i latou ; e leai foi se mea na le iloa ia te i latou i aso uma na latou i ai i Karamelu.

verses.en: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.
verses.sm: Ia e fesili i ou taulelea, latou te ta‘u atu ai ia te oe ; ma ia alofagia taulelea e oe ; auā o le aso lelei ua o atu ai i latou; ia e foai ane se mea e soona maua e oe i au auauna ma iou atalii o Tavita.

verses.en: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu taulelea o Tavita, ona latou fai atu lea ia Napalu, e pei o upu nei uma, i le igoa o Tavita, ona faalologo ai lea o i latou.

verses.en: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Napalu i auauna a Tavita, ua faapea mai, O ai ea Tavita ? o ai foi le atalii o Iese ? e toatele auauna i nei ona po, ua taitasi ma sola ese i o latou matai.

verses.en: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
verses.sm: Ou te ave ea a‘u areto, ma a‘u vai, ma a‘u manu ua ou fasia mo e sele mo a‘u, ou te foai atu ai i tagata ou te le iloa pe maifea i latou ? .

verses.en: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
verses.sm: Ona liliu mai ai lea o taulelea o Tavita i lo latou ala, ua latou toe foi mai; ua oo mai, ma latou ta‘u mai ia te ia> e tusa ma ia upu uma.

verses.en: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita i ona tagata, Ia taitasi ma fusi i lana pelu ; ona taitasi lea ma fusi i lana pelu, ua fusi foi e Tavita i lana pelu ; ona mulimuli ae lea ia Tavita pe atoa se toafa galau o tagata, a e faamuli le toalua lau i oloa.

verses.en: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
verses.sm: Na ta‘u atu e le tasi taulealea ia Apikaila le avā a Napalu, ua faapea, Faauta, na auina mai e Tavita o auauna nai le vao e faamanuia i lo tatou alii; a ua ia oso feai atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
verses.sm: Sa agalelei tasi ia tagata ia te i matou ; sa le afaina i matou, na leai foi sa matou mea e le iloa i aso uma na matou feoai ma i latou, a o i ai i matou i le vao.

verses.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.sm: Sa fai ma pa i latou ia i matou i le po ma le ao i aso uma na matou i ai ma i latou o leoleo mamoe.

verses.en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia e iloa, ma e mafaufau pe se a se mea e te faia, auā ua uma ona sama lona aiga uma ; o ia foi le tagata ulavale, e le matautala atu se tasi ia te ia.

verses.en: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
verses.sm: Ona faataalise ai lea o Apikaila, ua ia avane areto e lua selau, ma fagu pa‘u o uaina e lua, ma mamoe ua uma ona saunia e lima, ma sea o saito tunu e lirria, ma fuifui vine mago e selau, ma potopotogāmati e lua selau, ua ia faaee ai i luga o asini;

verses.en: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
verses.sm: ua fai atu i ona taulelea, Muamua ia outou i o‘u luma; faauta, ou te mulimuli atu ia te outou ; a ua ia le ta‘u atu ai ia Napalu lana tane.

verses.en: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
verses.sm: Sa tietie ia i luga o le asini, ma alu ifo i le itu e lilo o le mauga; faauta foi, o loo o ifo Tavita ma ona tagata ua feagai ma ia, na latou fetaiai ma ia.

verses.en: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.
verses.sm: Na fai ane Tavita, E moni, ua ou leoleo fua i mea uma a lena tagata i le vao, ua leai lava sana mea e tasi e le iloa ; a ua taui mai o ia ia te au le lelei i le leaga.

verses.en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.sm: Ia faapea ona fai e le Atua i e ita ia Tavita, ma ia faaopoopo i ai, pe afai ou te faasao, ia oo i le malama ae o le taeao, so latou uma o ia te ia e tulai atu i se aupa.

verses.en: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Apikaila ia Tavita, ona faataalise ai lea ona alu ifo o ia nai le asini, ua faapaū faō ia i luma o Tavita, ma ifo toele.

verses.en: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.
verses.sm: Ua faapaū mai i ona vae, ua fai mai, Le alii e, ia ia te au lenei agasala ; o a‘u nei lau auauna fafine, se‘i ou fai atu i ou fofoga, ma e faafofoga mai i upu a lau auauna fafine ;

verses.en: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.
verses.sm: aua ne‘i tuu e lo‘u alii i lona finagalo o amio a lena tagata ulavale, o Napalu ; auā e pei o lona igoa e faapea foi o ia ; o Napalu lona igoa, o loo ia te ia foi le valea ; a o a‘u lau auauna fafine, ou te lei iloa taulelea o lo‘u alii, na e auina atu ai.

verses.en: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
verses.sm: O lenei, le alii e, o loo soifua leova, o loo e soifua foi oe, ua taofi Ieova ia te oe, ina ne‘i e alu atu e sasaa le toto, ma taui atu ai e lou lima ia Napalu ; o lenei, ia pei o Napalu e ua ita ia te oe, atoa ma e ua saili e agaleaga i lo‘u alii.

verses.en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
verses.sm: O lea foi, o le alofa lenei ua au mai e lau auauna fafine i lo‘u alii; ia avatu ia i taulelea o loo mulimuli mai i lo‘u alii.

verses.en: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.
verses.sm: Ia e faamagalo le agasala a lau auauna fafine ; auā e faia lava e Ieova mo lo‘u alii se aiga Ieova, e lei iloa foi se Leaga ia te oe i ou aso uma.

verses.en: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
verses.sm: A ua tulai mai le tagata e tulituliloa ia te oe, o loo sailiili foi ia maliu oe ; a e fusifusia le ola o lo‘u alii i le ta“ui o le ola e Ieova lou Atua, a o le ola o e ita ia te oe, na te sasau i ai i le maatā.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;
verses.sm: A uma ona fai e Ieova i lo‘u alii o mea lelei uma na ia fetalai mai ai ia te oe, ma ua tofia oe e fai ma ta‘ita‘i e pule ia Isaraelu,

verses.en: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.
verses.sm: e le fai le mea nei ma faalavelave ia te oe, ma mea e tiga ai le finagalo o lo‘u alii, ina ua e le sasaa fua le toto, ma ua le taui atu e lo‘u alii le leaga. A faamanuia mai foi e Ieova i lo‘u alii, ia e manatu mai i lau auauna fafine.

verses.en: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita ia Apikaila, Faafetai ia Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, o le na auina mai oe i le aso nei e faafetaiai ia te au.

verses.en: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.
verses.sm: Faafetai foi i lou mafaufau, ma faafetai ia te oe, ina ua e taofi ia te au i lenei aso, ina ne‘i ou alu e sasaa le toto, ma taui le leaga e lo‘u lava lima.

verses.en: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.sm: E moni, o loo soifua Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, le na taofi mai ia te au, ina ia ou le fai se mea leaga ia te oe; auā ana e le faataalise ona sau e faafetaiai ia te au, po ua le toe ia Napalu i le malama ae o le taeao se tulai atu i se aupa.

verses.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.
verses.sm: Ona talia lea e Tavita nai lona lima o mea ua ia au mai ia te ia ; ua fai atu foi ia te ia, Alu ae ia oe ma le manuia i lou fale; faauta, ua ou faalogo i lau upu, ma ou alofa ia te oe.

verses.en: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o Apikaila ia Napalu; faauta, ua fai e ia le tausamiga i lona fale, pei o le tausamiga a se tupu; ua fiafia foi le loto o Napalu i totonu ia te ia o loo inu ia ua onā tele ai. Ua ia le ta‘u atu ai ia te ia se upu itiiti, po o se upu tele se‘i malama ae le taeao.

verses.en: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, ua mavae le onā i le uaina ia Napalu, ona ta‘u atu ai lea e lana avā ia te ia o nei mea uma ; ona oti ai lea o lona loto i totonu ia te ia, ua avea o ia pei se maa.

verses.en: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.
verses.sm: Pe atoa le sefulu o aso, ona taia lea o Napalu e Ieova;

verses.en: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
verses.sm: ua oti ai. Ua faalogo Tavita ua oti Napalu, ona fai ane lea o ia, Faafetai ia Ieova, ua ia taui atu i le agatele mai o Napalu, ma na taofi i lana auauna le leaga o Napalu i lona lava ulu. Ua alu le feau a Tavita e tautalatala ma Apikaila, ia fai mana avā.

verses.en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu auauna a Tavita ia Apikaila i Karamelu, ona iatou tautala atu lea ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Ua aauina mai i matou e Tavita ia te oe ina ia fai oe mana avā.

verses.en: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o ia, ua ifo toele; ua fai mai, Faauta i lau auauna fafine, ia fai ma auauna e mulumulu i vae o auauna a lo‘u alii.

verses.en: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
verses.sm: Ua faataalise ona tulai o Apikaila, ua tietie i luga o le asini, ua mulimuli foi ia te ia ona teine e toalima ; ua ia mulimuli atu i auauna a Tavita, ona fai ai lea o ia mana avā.

verses.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
verses.sm: Ua fai avā foi Tavita ia Ainoama le Isereelu, ua fai mana avā o i laua e toalua.

verses.en: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.
verses.sm: A ua foai atu e Saulo lona afafine o Mekala le avā, a Tavita ia Paleti, le atalii o Laisa, o le Kali.
